hero.heading: We've been almost everywhere.
hero.body: Local and Australia-wide group tours and charters from Houghton in the Adelaide Hills. Forty years on, we still know the roads, the stops and how a tour should be done.

tours.heading: Across town or across the country
tours.intro: Pick from our popular tours or have one tailored to your group. We price most trips as a package, so meals, attractions and entertainment are in with the coach.

types.title: Day tours
types.body: A leisurely pace, usually within 120 km of Adelaide, with driver commentary, morning tea from the coach, lunch and entry in one price.

types.title: Short breaks
types.body: Round trips that never take the same road twice — the Riverland, Port Lincoln, Kangaroo Island, the Grampians, Broken Hill and more.
popular: Whale watching at the Head of the Bight
Mildura, Swan Hill & the Sunraysia district

types.title: Extended holidays
types.body: The Red Centre, Canberra, Sydney and the Blue Mountains, the Gold Coast, Tasmania — with 2–4 night stays built in for a breather.

types.title: Charters
types.body: Just need the coach? We'll pick up and drop off wherever you like, in SA or Australia-wide — plus advice on where to stay and what to see.

tours.alsoOnOffer: Monthly mystery trips, weekends in the snowfields and full 5–7 day ski holidays, and tours tailored for seniors and special-interest groups.

safaris.heading: See the outback when the Sturt peas flower
safaris.body: Worried about gear and supplies? Don't be. Our safaris are fully self-contained and catered — a caravan park one night, a bush camp around the fire the next — and you see the same sights as an accommodated tour for considerably less.

travelClub.heading: Group prices, even when you travel on your own
body: Members get our regular newsletter of upcoming trips, pick the ones that suit them and pay group prices. Where we can, we'll collect you at or near your home.
Most members are over-50s, seniors and retirees — easy-going people who enjoy good company — and smaller clubs use it too when they can't make up the numbers.

outings.name: Mystery trips
outings.detail: Budget touring: coach cost plus complimentary morning tea; bring lunch or buy it nearby. A different place every time.

outings.name: Day tours
outings.detail: Set itinerary with driver commentary, morning tea, lunch and entertainment or entry fees in one price.

outings.name: Quick trips
outings.detail: Overnight accommodation, daily morning tea, breakfasts and evening meals. A round trip, so you see as much as possible.

outings.name: 3–6 day tours
outings.detail: Packaged with commentary, most morning teas, entry fees, accommodation and meals. We avoid travelling the same road twice.

outings.name: 7–21 day tours
outings.detail: Mix of one-night stays and 2–4 night stays so you get a break from moving.

coaches.heading: Quiet coaches, drivers who know the roads
coaches.body: Our Volvo and Mercedes coaches seat up to 48 and are kept in tip-top condition, so the hours on board pass quickly.
coaches.drivers: Our drivers hold hazard licences for the Victorian and NSW alpine areas and know outback dirt roads in all weather. On express runs over 12 hours, two drivers share the wheel with a regulation sleeper bunk on board.

contact.heading: Let's plan your next trip
contact.body: We're a small family business just north-east of Adelaide, so our overheads are low and we pass that on. Plenty of our regulars tell us our tours match — or beat — the upmarket operators. Tell us what you have in mind and we'll help with the rest.

terms._note: Summary of the Terms & Conditions page on the old site. Have the owner confirm before publishing.
terms.deposits: Within 7 days of confirming a booking, a suitable deposit (by agreement or as set out in the itinerary) is required on all long-distance charters and tours. Day trips don't normally need a deposit unless we must pay one to hold entertainment or services.
terms.localChartersAndTours: Full payment on the day for charters; payment in full before departure for tours that include meals, entertainment, entry fees or services.
terms.longDistance: Charters: full payment 7 days before departure. Tours including accommodation, meals, entertainment and entry: paid in full at least 21 days before departure.
terms.refunds: At management's discretion. Cancellation or full travel insurance is strongly recommended. Money paid to third parties on your behalf is subject to their policies. Health-related cancellations need a doctor's certificate. Where practical, we'll let you take the same tour later at the same price or credit the fare to another tour.
